scope: Outbound no-auth HTTPS Streamable HTTP MCP integration

test_reports.note: Collected JVM/Robolectric reports include build variants; these are test-case executions, not unique device asks.

coverage: Saved configuration decoding, real discovery/provider/harness/dispatch path with deterministic fake network boundaries
Negotiated protocol versions 2025-11-25, 2025-06-18 and 2025-03-26; session/version headers
Paginated tools/list, missing tool capability, wrong response IDs and repeated cursors
JSON and multiline SSE, byte/depth bounds, malformed/truncated input, unsupported content types
Cancellation disconnects a blocked HTTP connection; own timeouts do not cancel caller conversations
Unsupported server-request rejection and observed list-changed notification
MCP grants, denied/forged calls without dispatch, distinct stable aliases, cache and refresh
Removal during suspended configuration reads cannot republish tools or dispatch stale bindings
Authentication failures and one-server timeout isolation
Session expiry without call replay, unknown outcomes, malformed-result rejection
Explicit text truncation and binary payload omission
Typed nested arguments, canonical JSON and versioned checkpoint failure outcomes; legacy decoding
independent_review: All substantive findings addressed; final read-only review approved.
limitations: OAuth, arbitrary authentication headers, stdio, legacy HTTP+SSE, inbound listener, sampling, elicitation, tasks and remote resource fetching are not implemented in this increment.
Accepted input schemas use a conservative subset; references, regex constraints and unknown keywords are omitted with a notice.
Binary remote results are reported but not converted into deliverable artifacts.
Shared channel wiring was inspected; live Telegram/SMS/API/voice/photo/typed behavior with the user's server remains untested.
next_acceptance: On request, install the debug APK without uninstalling or clearing data.
Open MCP settings and Refresh the existing saved server; verify Ready and tool count.
As owner, list that server's tools and explicitly request a known read-only tool.
Record sanitized real server/device evidence separately; never count fixture results as live acceptance.
